description: This file contains Python code that defines functions for generating C++ source code for JSON-RPC message handling, including event emission, RPC registration, and code scaffolding for a plugin-based system.

methods.name: EmitEvent(emit, root, event, params_type, legacy = False)
methods.description: Generates C++ code for emitting a JSON-RPC event, including constructing the method prototype, serializing parameters, and handling optional legacy code paths.

methods.description: Writes the header part of the generated C++ code, including includes, namespace declarations, and version information.

methods.name: _EmitRpcEpilogue(root, emit, ns)
methods.description: Writes the closing parts of the generated C++ file, including namespace closures.

methods.name: _EmitVersionCode(emit, version)
methods.description: Generates C++ code defining version constants.

methods.name: _EmitRpcCode(root, emit, ns, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
methods.description: Coordinates the emission of the full RPC C++ code, including versioning, registration, and event code.

methods.name: EmitRpcCode(root, emit, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the full RPC C++ source code from the root schema and emitting it into provided emitter.

methods.name: EmitRpcVersionCode(root, emit, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
